title: Chapter 99: A Farce
content:
Chapter 99: A Farce

"Hahaha! Let's fight! Let's see if your strength matches your temperament!"

Meng didn't care and rushed directly to the general of the Tengu tribe.

The general of the Tengu tribe was ordered by Gou Zhengqiang to lead his troops to attack, but he found that it did not play the role he should have. After letting the troops of various territories attack, he knew that he would never go back today.

The past flashed through his mind. He didn't expect that his final outcome would be to fall on such a ridiculous battlefield.

With a sigh in his heart, he drove his mount to accelerate the charge, raised his spear, concentrated his mind, and gathered all his life's learning to stab the rushing Meng with a peak shot!

Meng faced the stabbing spear, did not dodge, swung his sword and chopped, and directly took this move head-on.

"钪锵!" With a sound, the weapons of the two people collided fiercely, and a huge sound of metal clashing sounded.

The general of the Tengu tribe suddenly felt numb all over his body, and the spear almost slipped out of his hand, but Meng was not affected at all, and the strength of the two was immediately judged.

"Haha, too weak!"

After the blow, Meng felt refreshed, and turned the giant tiger flexibly, rushing to the Tengu general again.

"Cease fire!"

A team of Tengu cavalry rushed out from one side of the battlefield, shouting for a ceasefire!

"The Tengu lord has ordered! Please stop fighting immediately!"

Unfortunately, Meng pretended not to hear it.

He raised his knife and chopped off the head of the Tengu general. His knife was as fast as lightning. The Tengu general, who was numb all over and had not yet fully recovered, felt a chill on his neck and lost consciousness in the world.

Meng cut off the head of the Tengu general with a clean and neat knife, with his helmet and armor, and watched the once invincible Tengu general disappear from this world.

The Zerg puppy was not idle either, and quickly pounced on the injured Tengu cavalry, waving his knife arm and killing them all.

Menghe Zerg had no scruples or mercy for the Tengu cavalry who dared to launch an attack. They almost instantly destroyed two thousand elite Tengu cavalry without any damage, including a Tengu general who was of high status and strong strength.

The Tengu cavalry and mounts that died on the battlefield all turned into light and disappeared, leaving only their weapons and equipment and personal belongings.

Seeing such a scene, the team of Tengu cavalry that rushed over slowly stopped and dared not move forward.

Gou Zheng stared blankly at the Tengu cavalry and the general being killed together. Behind him was a large army of nearly 100,000 people watching the battle quietly. Except for the nearly 100 cavalry guards around him, no one on the battlefield would obey his orders.

"Rebellion! Rebellion! You are all rebels!"

Gou Zheng muttered to himself.

"Mr. Gou Zheng, you stole the token of the adults and privately mobilized troops to provoke a war. You violated the clan rules. Come with us!"

The team of Tengu cavalrymen who came saw that the situation on the battlefield was irreversible, and went straight to Gou Zheng, accused him of a crime, and took him away directly.

The new Tengu cavalry general stopped in front of the Tengu army and shouted at the lords and nearly 100,000 troops: "Do you know what you are doing?"

"Disobeying orders before the battle! It's equivalent to rebellion! It's a dead end!"

"In view of the special circumstances this time, I will spare your lives for the time being, and all your contributions in this battle will be offset!"

"You can go back to the territory on your own!"

After saying these words, the Tengu cavalry general looked at the direction of the Zerg again, and left without any intention of communicating with Wu Qing and others.

Wu Qing watched the performance of the Tengu cavalry from afar. He felt that the Tengu clan had been doing things on purpose all along. Although it seemed unreasonable to Wu Qing, it must have its purpose and reason.

There were several hosts above the Tengu clan's army. He heard clearly what the Tengu cavalry generals said to the armies of various territories.

Those lords and armies were in trouble. They had rested well and could go back with their merits after today.

They didn't expect to encounter such a thing and get involved in a vortex of troubles that they couldn't even sort out.

Although they got their lives back today, they would definitely have a hard time in the future. This war, which cost them a huge price, did not bring them any benefits except for the basic luck within the rules. It was a big loss.

With the stain of disobeying orders before the battle today, there was a gap between them and the Tengu clan they depended on, and the original trust was gone.

The Tengu Clan’s army, without seeing the Tengu Clan’s high-ranking officials appear, knew that the Tengu Clan’s order just now was the final decision.

The major lords met, had a brief chat, and were ready to withdraw their troops back to their territories.

At this time, Meng rode a giant tiger and came over, stopping not far from the major lords.

“Lords, you have suffered an unexpected disaster today, but your behavior today is considered to be a severance from the Tengu Clan!”

“With the current situation of the Tengu Clan, they will do something unexpected at any time!”

“Instead of staying in the Tengu Clan with fear, you might as well join our independent territory alliance!”

“Our alliance has the protection of the Zerg, which is no weaker than the Tengu Clan, and the Zerg is a newly born race, which shows its racial character!”

“The Zerg acts openly and fairly, and there will definitely not be so many shitty things!”

“The alliance has just been established and is in a period of rapid development. Welcome everyone to join and work together to counterattack the evil god camp!”

Meng began to poach corners. These lords who were destined to be rejected by the Tengu clan were good potential development targets for the alliance.

Meng's voice was not loud this time, and no one else could hear him except the nearby lords.

Of course, Meng did not do this to keep secrets. As soon as he said this, there would definitely be a lord who reported it to the Tengu clan. There was no need to keep it secret.

He whispered these words not to be heard by the Tengu clan, just to make most of the lords here feel better.

Lest there be any misunderstanding that he was persecuting these lords who were in a difficult situation.

"Thank you for the alliance's favor! It's getting late, we must rush back to the territory now!"

"Otherwise there will be no place to stay at night!"

All the major lords remained silent. In the end, the Ox Clan lord who took the lead in disobedience at the critical moment came out and said something.

No matter what happens in the future, if he talks to Meng here for a few more words, it may lead to strong suppression from the Tengu clan. Even the lord of the Ox clan does not dare to say more.

"Okay! See you later!"

Meng didn't say anything more, turned around and left.

His words were spoken, and some seeds were planted. It would be a good thing for a few of them to take root, sprout, and bear fruit in the future.

The Zerg puppies drove the surviving lizard mounts of the Tengu clan back to the city, and Wu Qing sent a team of parasites to clean up the battlefield. This farce-like conflict ended like this.

The Tengu clan lost two thousand elite cavalry and one general. The lords and armies of the major territories that survived this war lost all their military exploits, and they were also at odds with their masters.

Wu Qing knew that the matter between the Zerg clan and the Tengu clan was far from over.
